n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: The pneumatic tube to Records. Pell's notes come up it rolled, sealed and faintly resentful.

send.speaker: narrator
send.text: Thunk. A canister. Inside, the originals and a slip: 'Uncreased, please. - O.P.'

none.speaker: narrator
none.text: Nothing to send for. The tube hisses quietly to itself.
